rationale: Leftover indices contiguously sliced per worker.id, so workers overlap and miss others. Borderline sharding vs data_loading: chose data_loading per table A (shard duplicate/missing). Detect by gathering worker-emitted sample ids and checking union==full set with no overlap (P3 cross-rank/worker, pi_topo+pi_precond). check_stage=other (data loader, not a model phase).
